summary: Group-scoped hashing is genuinely verified for single-glob groups (content-not-labels, every file within one glob's match set, union across groups, gate-level invalidation), but every REQ-013.2.1-annotated test declares exactly one glob per side per group; a mutant that hashes content of only the first evidence glob's matches (evidence: [a, b] where a file is matched only by b) or applies a group via only the first tests glob passes all annotated tests, so the multi-glob list edge productions of the REQ-013.1.1 declared shape are unprobed — the only multi-glob list in the suite (tests/evidence-groups.test.ts:220) is the REQ-013.2.2 declaration test whose invalidation is declaration-driven, not content-driven.
